Metaphor: ReFantazio is a game much beloved by Oliver, with John recently dipping into it for the first time - so it was with much interest that the duo checked out the Nintendo Switch 2 port in its demo form. And there's good news and bad news: TAA-based upscaling, potentially DLSS, is used on Switch 2 and it delivers some clear image quality advantages even over PS5 - but at rest, a bug is present that looks like a bizarre 2560x720 presentation docked. It's a bug that should be fixed - and hopefully bringing attention to the problem will see that happen before the game's official launch.

Thanks to Enshrouded for sponsoring this video. Enshrouded 1.0 is available now on PC and PS5 with support for 16 players, upgraded graphics and performance boosts. Enjoy the full story, an entirely new biome, upgraded combat systems along with Sparkworks customisation. Find out more: https://connect.enshrouded.com/DF 

John is back from Japan so he tells Coury what he got up to while there.  With the help of friend in Japan, Matt Papa, he takes us through going to the Tokyo Game Show, visiting the Extinct Media Museum, visiting game developer M2 and more!

Matt Papa is a fellow retro game lover and localization professional from New Jersey based out of Tokyo. Matt worked on the localizations for over 30 titles, including the Gunvolt series, Gal*Gun series, Blaster Master Zero series, and most recently, Magical Girl Witch Trials. He streams retro games all on original hardware over on Twitch, and is in the process of building retro gaming content on YouTube!
